Install a Japanese font (such as Yu Gothic or Meiryo) in "Settings > Personalization > Fonts", or add the Japanese supplemental fonts in "Settings > System > Optional features", then try again. Subtitle files (SRT, ASS) aren't affected, and you can still export them.
